hypotheses.C0_panel_is_prospectively_held_out: The coverage panel begins after every panel used for geometry discovery, semantic labeling, and semantic validation.
hypotheses.C1_continuous_code_beats_centroid_code: Rank-four PCA has higher contextual edge-write fidelity than four-centroid quantization in at least twelve of eighteen layers.
hypotheses.C2_geometric_atlas_covers_material_natur: Across layers with a selected geometric mode, gated atlas modes contain at least 15% of importance-weighted native edge energy.
hypotheses.C3_validated_semantic_modes_cover_materi: Across layers with a prospectively validated semantic mode, those modes contain at least 10% of importance-weighted native edge energy.
hypotheses.C4_semantic_binding_beats_head_permutati: Validated semantic modes have higher contextual edge-write fidelity than the 95th percentile of head-permuted, count-matched centers.
hypotheses.C5_route_reconstruction_predicts_context: Across layer-method cells, route coefficient fidelity and contextual edge-write fidelity have Pearson correlation at least 0.70.
hypotheses.C6_semantic_coverage_is_not_a_single_thr: At thresholds 0.60, 0.70, and 0.80, validated semantic modes each contain at least 5% of model-wide attention-edge energy and retain positive model-wide edge fidelity. This gate was locked after seeing the primary 0.70 result but before running the sweep.
